title: Quasiconformal and Sobolev distortion of dimension
summary: We review a selection of the literature on the distortion of metric notions of dimension under quasiconformal, quasisymmetric, and Sobolev mappings. Our story begins with Gehring's landmark 1973 higher integrability theorem for quasiconformal maps, along with its implications for the distortion of Hausdorff dimension. Astala's 1994 solution to the planar higher integrability conjecture led to renewed interest in the subject in two dimensions.
